verses.text: All these blessings and curses I have set before you will come on you. Then, in the nations where the LORD your God scatters you, you will remember them.
And when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey him with all your heart and all your soul, doing everything I am commanding you today,
then the LORD your God will bring you back from captivity. He will have mercy on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.
Even if you have been sent away to the farthest land under heaven, the LORD your God will gather you from there and bring you back.
The LORD your God will bring you into the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will own it again. He will make you more successful and more numerous than your ancestors.
The LORD your God will change your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you will love him with all your heart and all your soul, and live.
The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies, who hate you and who treated you cruelly.
You will again obey the LORD and keep all his commands that I am giving you today.

Then the LORD your God will make you successful in all the work of your hands. He will bless you with many children, many young animals, and rich crops. The LORD will again be glad to do good to you, just as he was glad to do good to your ancestors,
if you obey the LORD your God and keep his commands and rules written in this Book of the Law, and turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and all your soul.
What I am commanding you today is not too hard for you or out of your reach.
It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, "Who will go up to heaven to get it and tell it to us, so that we can obey it?"
Nor is it on the other side of the sea, so that you have to ask, "Who will cross the sea to get it and tell it to us, so that we can obey it?"
No, the word is very near you. It is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you can obey it.
Look, today I am setting before you a choice between life and good things, and death and disaster.

For today I command you to love the LORD your God, to live the way he wants, and to keep his commands, rules, and laws. Then you will live and grow in number, and the LORD your God will bless you in the land you are going in to take over.
But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, and you are led astray to bow down to other gods and worship them,
I warn you today that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to take over.
Today I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live.

Choose to love the LORD your God, obey him, and hold tightly to him. For the LORD is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he promised to give your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
